messages:
Jordan: Quick weekly health check for Saffron cohort — tokens + throughput trends. Main takeaways: overall token growth, one onboarding lag, one short-lived error window.

Jordan: Top-level numbers
- Week tokens (all cohort): 9.4M ; WoW +9% ; QoQ +27%
- Avg throughput (tokens/sec): 3.2k ; 10-min peak 4.6k
- P95 latency (gen): 160ms (steady)
- 5xx + timeout rate: 0.6% this week (was 0.2% last week) :rotating_light:
- Estimated weekly hosted spend: $4.1k (projected month ~$16.5k)

Jordan: Account flags
- EchoBank: onboarding stalled — tokens flat WoW, latency higher (~P95 220ms). Possibly integration retry/backoff issue.
- SaffronOps (internal pilot): strong growth; recommend moving to reserved Dedicated pilot next month.
- Cinder Systems: short 5xx burst Thu 03:14-03:20 UTC, ~45 events; likely infra throttling during small maintenance.

Nina: data snippet (ran 30s ago)
- SQL: SELECT acct, SUM(tokens) wk, AVG(tps) avg_tps FROM usage WHERE cohort='saffron' AND week='2026-03-09' GROUP BY acct;
- EchoBank: 48k tokens week, avg tps 45
- SaffronOps: 1.05M tokens week, avg tps 900
- Cinder Systems: 22k tokens week, errors concentrated 03:14-03:20 UTC

Omar: Ops note — I checked infra windows, we had a short maintenance on redwood-gpu-12 at 03:10 UTC; autoscaler overshot and a handful of pods restarted. Investigating why circuit-breaker tripped.

MetricsBot: alert: cluster redwood-gpu-12 pod-restarts spike at 2026-03-19T03:12:08Z ; restart-count=7 over 8m.

Ken: Finance check — EchoBank is on a trial with $5k credit cap, they've used ~60% of credits. If onboarding remains low we should offer targeted help rather than automatic credit top-up.

Jordan: Plan
1) @Nina share a 4-week WoW trend chart (tokens + tps) for EchoBank & Cinder by EOD.
2) @Omar validate autoscaler config and add a guard so short maintenance doesn't trigger circuit-breakers.
3) @Ken prep a renewal-friendly enablement offer (30-min deep-dive + 1mo burst) we can propose to EchoBank.
4) Ops/Onboarding: tentatively schedule EchoBank pairing session Thu.

Nina: Uploaded quick chart to /drive/cs/saffron/week-over-week_trends.png and will add QoQ cohort breakdown tomorrow morning.

Jordan: Thanks — next sync same time next week. Short replies only please. :thumbsup:
